title: Rename Code_of_Conduct.md to CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
author: moezdil
summary: GitHub looks for CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md (all caps) to recognize the file as a community health file. With the current name, GitHub does not detect it and shows this repo as missing a code of conduct in the community standards checklist.
